summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload on npm install
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is a variable-name-obfuscated script that, at npm install time, detects the host platform and libc, downloads the Bun runtime zip from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the bun binary to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated blob (obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation, single-letter identifiers) whose network destinations are reassembled at runtime from a rotated string array, defeating static URL extraction. The advertised purpose is Express/Prometheus middleware, which has no need for a second language runtime or for a 727KB obfuscated init module. The dropped Bun binary is used to execute code that Node-based scanners will not resolve, evading inspection. Execution fires automatically on `npm install` with no user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
